title: Employ staff under the Seagoing Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Seagoing Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Seagoing Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers in respect of their operations in the seagoing industry and their employees in the classification listed in clause 14 — Classifications and minimum rates and clause A.1.1 — Classifications and minimum rates to the exclusion of any modern award.

reach.condition: vessels that proceed to sea on voyages outside bays, harbours or rivers (cl 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Seagoing Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 For the purposes of clause 4.1 , seagoing industry means the operation of vessels trading as cargo vessels, passenger vessels or operated as research vessels which, in the course of such trade or operation, proceed to sea (on voyages outside the limits of bays, harbours or rivers) .

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Seagoing Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
